script:
set -euo pipefail
APP="/Users/Shared/WorkspaceBersama/ChatGPTHeadlessPool/Chat-Lokal"
U="$(id -u)"
echo "RECOVER_START"
python3 -m py_compile "$APP/chat_local_injector.py" "$APP/chat_local_transport_v4.py"
echo "COMPILE=PASS"
launchctl bootout "gui/$U/com.copytolive.chat-lokal-mainbridge-v3" 2>/dev/null || true
PL="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.copytolive.chat-lokal-mainbridge-v3.plist"
if [ -f "$PL" ]; then
  DST="$PL.DISABLED_BY_V4"
  [ -e "$DST" ] && DST="$PL.DISABLED_BY_V4.$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  mv "$PL" "$DST"
  echo "V3_PLIST_DISABLED=$DST"
fi
launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$U/com.copytolive.chat-lokal-injector"
sleep 3
for p in $(ps -axo pid=,command= | awk '/Chat-Lokal\/chat_local_main_bridge\.py$/ {print $1}'); do
  kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "LEGACY_MAINBRIDGE_STOPPED=$p"
done
LABEL='actions.runner.malfatihkita-cmyk-chat-lokal-relay-temp.Chat-Lokal-Temporary'
launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$U/$LABEL" 2>/dev/null || {
  cd "$HOME/.copytolive-chat-lokal/actions-runner-temp"
  ./svc.sh start
}
sleep 4
echo "HEALTH=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8765/healthz || true)"
echo "---PROCESSES---"
ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command= | grep -E 'chat_local_(injector|transport_v4|main_bridge|main_bridge_v3)\.py|Runner\.Listener|runsvc\.sh' | grep -v grep || true
echo "RECOVER_DONE"
